The '''Sevetta system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sevetta sector/Legends|Sevetta sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevetta/Legends|Sevetta]].
